translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Wupwutiwen Jesus
Noan oatonaan nge Soamwoonin Rome we Augustus a akkiuneo pwe epwe yor paaepaen fainaaw noan oanongaen faniuw kka nemaeniaen Rome.
Reen igiwe aeyewaen paaepae a rhaepetae nge Quirinius minne eno pwe governor reen Syria.
Erhai me erhai nge enoa foatogi itan reen aan taeninimw.
Joseph a noa saengi Nazareth noan Galilee a noa ngaeni Bethlehem noan Judea, igiwe esiupwutiw king David me ee. Joseph a noa igiwe pwe igiwe iiy teoteeon David.
A noa pwe enoa foatogi iteer me Maria, rhooapwut we a no pwe kkefoaton. Niewe a pwoopwo,
oatowe reno Bethlehem, a toori oaton aan supw aetewe naiun.
Niewe a timenewaegini aetemwaaen we mesaemmwaei naiun, nge a tiugiumi nong noan mengaag nge e oana nong noan miniwe nenien anan maan, pwe igiwe esooar no nenieer me noan imwaen waseona we.
Rhooan Neginegin Sheep me Angkenus Kkewe
Eyor aekkaerhai rhooan neginegin sheep reno wooan menaai nee pwoong re aefaenniir naiiur maan.
Erhai naiun Soamwoon angkenus a pwae ngaeniir, nge nningen Soamwoon a ttinitiw wooar. Ra igin mesag,
nge angkenus we a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw mesag! Ngaang iya pwigito eew kkepas mwamwaai reemi, kkepas een epwe pwigito eew kker temoag ngaeniir oanongeer aeremas.
Raaenin eei noan aepinoamw we aepinoamwon David rhooan aemenaw we aaemi a supw — Kristus we Soamwoon!
Ieen minne epwe aniugiuniugiuw ngaenigaemi: oawpwe noa rhuungi erhai wonigaet e tiugiutiug noan mengaag nge ewon noan nenien anan maan.”
Ese mmwaei mwo nge eew mwirhaen angkenus a pwae noa me oaron angkenus we erhai, ra aepingepinga Deus noan aar keon:

content.text: “Sia fang ssoar ngaeni Deus na eno wooai naaeng,
nge oapoas enoa ngaeniir rhooakkena e mwamwaai nee tipan wooar!”

content: Oatowe angkenus kkewe ra nigitiir ra sefaaen noa naaeng, rhooan neginegin sheep kkewe ra kkepas fengaen nee fineer pwe, “Sa noa Bethlehem sipwe noa weri meeta minne a wen, minne Soamwoon a aengaenigirh.”
Iwe ra siu mwetekkaei noa me igiwe, nge ra noa weri Maria me Joseph iwe nge reweri wonigaet we ewon noan nenien anan maan.
Oatowe ra weri aetewe, nge ra aengaeniir rhooawe meeta we angkenus e iura reen aetewe.
Oanongeer iyo kkewe re rongorong miniwe nge ra mwaar reen miniwe mwaenieer rhooawe rhooan neginegin sheep kkewe.
Maria a maeng ngaeni oanongaen minikkeei nge a niuwaennei nong rhag nee tipan.
Rhooan neginegin sheep ra sefaaen, nge ra aepingepinga Deus reen igiwe meeta kkewe ra rongorong nge ra weri; nge taeppen rhag miniwe angkenus we a aengaeniir.
Ra Aeita Jesus
Enoa eew week weni mwirin, reen oatowe aetewe epwene circumcise, ra aeita ngaeni pwe Jesus, itiwe angkenus a fasiun ngaenneer weni mmwaen aan supw.
Ra Pwigi Noa Jesus Noan Temple we
A toori oatowe Joseph me Maria repwe feeori eew pwaengepwaengin aenimenim, pwe ina miniwe oasoapwosoapw we aaen Moses e aepesa. Iwe ra pwigi noa aetewe Jerusalem pwe repwe noa pwaeri ngaeni Soamwoon,
pwe ina miniwe effoat noan oasoapwosoapw we aaen Soamwoon pwe, “Oanongaen mesaemmwaei naiiur aetemwaaen nge repwe aeyimweoiiur ngaeni Soamwoon.”
Ra pwai noa pwe repwe noa aeni maenigaech riiurhai dove aere riiurhai aeppaen pigeons, pwe ina miniwe e fasiun no noan oasoapwosoapw we aaen Soamwoon.
Noan oatonaan nge eno erhai mwaaen itan Simeon eno noan Jerusalem. Iiy erhai mwaaen reepiy nge e mwamwaai noan menewan nge e wewweti oatona epwe cchipw Israel. Espritu Santus a teeotiw wooan
nge a aniugiuniugiuw ngaeni pwe iiy esoapw mae weni mmwaen epwe weri Kristus we Soamwoon e ppwoneei.
Espritu Santus a paeni Simeon a itinong noan Temple we. Oatowe rhooawe inan me seman ra pwigito goagoa we noan Temple we pwe repwe feeori ngaeni meeta we oasoapwosoapw e iura,
Simeon a ammwarhiu aetewe noan paiun nge a fang aerhigerhig ngaeni Deus:

content.text: “Igina Soamwoon, een wa iseni ppwon we oamw,
nge wa mwiuti ngaeni noawumw rhooan akkiuneo pwe epwe noa noan oapoas.
Iya weri ngaeni mesaei oamw engaengaen menaw,
iwe een wa oamoannatae me weni mmweer oanongeer aeremas:
eew seram epwe pwaeri ngaeniir re Gentiles mwerhaen na oamw
iwe me pwigito nning ngaeniir noawumw re Israel.”

content: Rhooawe inan me seman aetewe ra mwaar reen meeta kkewe Simeon e iura reen aetewe.

Simeon a aepiniir nge a aengaeni Maria, iwe inaen aetewe, “Aeteei a ffin tae me reen Deus pwe epwe oatoaropa nge e aemenewaer towunepaen re Israel. Iiy epwe no pwe eew aeginn me reen Deus pwe towunepaen aeremas repwe appaniuwaeni noan aar kkepas,
iwe a pwaeritae noan niunniuwaen mwoanomwoan kena aar. Nge niemaam eweei kaengin saeitan, epwe fereei pwunnomw.”

Eno erhai profeta tugufaeyi itan Anna nge a mae noa pwiuniuwan. Nge iiy naiun Phanuel saengi aeinang we aaen Asher. Fisuuw raeg aan pwiuppwiuniuw nge emae noa pwiuniuwan. Nge igina a waniig me faawu raegin. Iiy ese nigiti Temple we; pwoong me raaen nge e aesirowu noa rhag Deus, e aecchigipin nge e memmaeipin.
Noan rhag awa we e tooto nge a fang aerhigerhig ngaeni Deus nge a fioangei mmwenen aetewe ngaeniir oanongeer rhooa kkewe re iya wetiwet ngaeni Deus pwe epwe saeneti noa Jerusalem.
Ra Sefaaen Ngaeni Nazareth
Igiwe Joseph me Maria ra moannon feeori minikkewe eno noan anniug we aaen Soamwoon, nge ra sefaaen ngaeni miniwe aepinoamwoor iwe Nazareth me noan Galilee.
A tootae aetewe nge amamaaw noa, nge a sseog noan reepiy nge Deus a no wooan.
Aet we Jesus me Noan Temple we
Oanongaen raeg nge rhooawe inaen me seman Jesus ra noa Jerusalem pwe repwe noa tapweei gupwunon Passover we.
Oatowe a seig me ruwowu raegin Jesus nge ra noa tapweei gupwun we taeppen rhag miniwe regaen feoffeeori.
Enoa moanno noa gupwun we, rhooawe ra sefaaen noa nee pwuguseer, nge Jesus a notiw noan Jerusalem. Rhooawe inan me seman rese giuneei minneei;
iir re niuwaennei pwe eno reer rhooanap we, iwe eraaen nniuw aar nennoa nge a rhaepetae aar kiukkiutta fetaeneei aetewe me neeiir aei oaroor me maereyaereer.
Nge iir rese weri, iwe ra sefaaen noa giutta me Jerusalem.
Wooan ayeoniuraenin aar giut nge ra noa weri me noan Temple we, emooat neeiir sinsein Jews kkewe, e aiussaening ngaeniir nge e kekkepas aeiineo ngaeniir.
Oanongeer rhooa kkewe re rongorong mwaenian nge remwaar noa reen aesefaaenin kkepas aeiyeg kkewe aan.

Rhooawe inan me seman re riutae reen igiwe ra noa weri, iwe nge rhooapwut we inan a aengaeni pwe, “Naeyi, meeta wa feeori ngaenigemaem minneei reen? Pwe ngaang me mwaaen e semoamw aeiya gin noanineeng reen aemaem giutta fetaeneog.”
Nge iya paniuwaeniir nge a iura pwe, “Meeta aaemi oawnoa giutta fetaeneaei reen? Oawse giuneei pwe ngaang ipwe no noan imwaen minna Semaei?”
Nge iir rese metaf reen miniwe e iura.
Iwe Jesus a tapweei sefaaeniir noa Nazareth, nge a noa aiussaening ngaeniir. Miniwe inaan a iseni nong rhag oanongan nee tipan.
Jesus a temoag tae wooan oanongan me aan reepiy me temoagon rhaengiin me reen Deus me aeremas.
